Paid/Commercial
Intro/Plot Details:
Transported to another region of the distant world that she resides on, Nefersila Takumis prepares to be forcibly wiped of all knowledge of her past and placed into the care of the foster ministry at her destination. But before she can give up that knowledge, she needs to pass it along to a neutral party so that the details are not lost to time. Using her knowledge of the mana arts, Nefersila initiates a telepathic communication which inadvertently reaches across the depths of existence and connects her with Kyla Larson of Earth.
Beset by physical defects incurred at the time of her birth, Kyla lacks any kind of functional ability in the majority of her body. But what she lacks in motor functions is made up for in terms of intelligence, such that she realizes the nature of the communication and its source almost immediately. Surprisingly, her brother Alan (who is fully functioning in his physical condition by comparison) also picks up on the communication and the two siblings work together to understand and document every detail of Nefersila's heritage so that it is kept safe.
Referring to their distant associate as Neffie, Kyla and Alan forge a deep bond with her and maintain contact even after the knowledge is wiped away. This leads them into the process of starting a research project which ultimately succeeds in creating the first documented passage between two vastly different worlds. Sending their cousin Padma through the portal upon the moment that Nefersila's protection is ascribed for the purpose of maintaining her safety, the siblings agree to maintain secrecy regarding the existence of the distant world and its inhabitants to avoid causing any sort of public issue. In exchange, Nefersila serves as a mentor to Kyla and utilizes their shared knowledge to advance the technological provisions of her own world.
Nineteen years have passed since the establishment of their initial communication. During that time, Kyla received the neural implant which allows her to utilize robotic armor to make up for her paralysis and function in a manner not unlike that of more able-bodied people, which she has used to her advantage in defending innocent bystanders from hate and bullying. Willingly putting herself into the middle of many physical altercations and fighting back with decisive force, Kyla's pattern of public defense has attracted the attention of the New York City police department, and by consequence she is now one of the most successful officers on the force. Meanwhile, Nefersila has used the advancements allowed by her association with Kyla to establish a watchpoint in the vicinity of her adopted home for the purpose of keeping track of matters related to the circumstances of their initial communication. However, a sudden loss of global communication at the watchpoint - combined with a prophetic discovery within the writings of Nefersila's world - have revealed a matter whereby the stakes of the matter by which they are connected are far higher than any of them had ever anticipated, threatening to advance the efforts of an intentionally-unnamed party to destroy all that is known to existence in the name of a false interpretation of destiny itself.
